## Notes & Examples

### Math Library Conventions

The math library provides vector, matrix, quaternion, and utility operations. All math functions follow consistent patterns: **pure functions** return new values, **`*Into` variants** write to an output parameter (zero allocation), and **out parameters come first**. Matrices are column-major for WebGPU compatibility.

**Example: Common math operations**
```js
import { vec3, vec3Add, vec3Scale, vec3Normalize } from 'engine/core/math/MathVec3.js';
import { mat4, mat4Multiply, mat4Perspective, mat4LookAt } from 'engine/core/math/MathMat4.js';
import { quat, quatMultiply, quatFromEuler } from 'engine/core/math/MathQuat.js';

// Vectors
const pos = vec3(1, 2, 3);
const dir = vec3Normalize(vec3(1, 0, 0));

// Matrix: projection * view * model
const proj = mat4Perspective(60 * Math.PI/180, 16/9, 0.1, 1000);
const view = mat4LookAt([0, 5, 10], [0, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]);
const model = mat4();  // Identity

// Into variant for hot loops (no allocation)
const mvp = mat4();
mat4Multiply(mvp, view, model);  // mvp = view * model
mat4Multiply(mvp, proj, mvp);    // mvp = proj * view * model

// Quaternion rotation
const rot = quatFromEuler(0, Math.PI/4, 0);  // 45° Y rotation
```
